description: Bulk delete alerts for a given organization. Use when you need to delete multiple alerts at once. ⚠️ This endpoint is currently in beta and may be subject to change.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for bulk deleting alerts from a Sentry organization.

id.description: The ID of the alert you'd like to delete. Multiple IDs can be provided to delete multiple alerts at once.
id.title: Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization the resource belongs to.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

project.description: The IDs of projects to filter by. '-1' means all available projects. For example: '/?project=1234&project=56789' or '/?project=-1'
project.title: Project

query.description: An optional search query for filtering alerts to delete.
query.title: Query

inputSchema.title: DeleteBulkAlertsRequest

name: delete_bulk_alerts

DeleteBulkAlertsResponse.description:
Response schema for bulk deleting alerts from a Sentry organization.

Returns HTTP 204 No Content on successful deletion with an empty response body.
The successful deletion is indicated solely by the 204 status code.
DeleteBulkAlertsResponse.title: DeleteBulkAlertsResponse
